Scientific & Data Leadership: Apply a scientific approach to product discovery. Analyze performance data to validate hypotheses and drive data-informed decision-making across the organization. Stakeholder Management: Act as a key partner for the Leadership Team, delivering clear, data-backed insights and recommendations that influence company-wide strategy. Team Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and scale a team of product managers, fostering a culture of accountability, growth, and high-quality PRD standards. Cross-functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary point of contact for Engineering, Data Science, and Design teams to prioritize features and resolve technical/business trade-offs. Qualifications and Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager in software development (SaaS, EdTech, or AI-driven products). Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related technical/scientific field. jobs.title: ML Research Intern in Agentic Runtime Systems
jobs.description: Our mission Constructor’s mission is to enable all educational organisations to provide high-quality digital education to 10x people with 10x efficiency.  With strong expertise in machine intelligence and data science, Constructor’s all-in-one platform for education and research addresses today’s pressing educational challenges: access inequality, tech clutter, and low engagement of students. Please send your resume in English only. Interns are NOT eligible for equipment and other benefits as the position is temporary. The Reality The frontier models are converging into commodities; the engine is no longer the differentiator. The scarcity in 2026 is not the model. We are not looking for people to fine-tune Llama on toy datasets or write "better prompts." We are building the runtime systems that turn probabilistic token generation into reliable workers that finish 50-step tasks without spiraling. We are solving the math of multi-step reliability through engineering, not wishful thinking. What You Will Solve You will work on the  Agentic Harness , treating the LLM as a component within a larger, deterministic control system. Your research will focus on: Architecting loops that survive error accumulation. You will build verification layers that force the agent to recognize its own hallucinations and self-correct. You will implement systems where the agent compiles its own constraints and the harness enforces them via constrained decoding or external execution. You will optimise KV-cache hit rates and design "restorable compression" strategies to prevent attention decay. Who We Are Looking For We are looking for  systems thinkers  who happen to know ML, not the other way around. You know that a demo is not a product. You are interested in the "boring" engineering: state machines, retries, idempotency, serialisation — that actually makes agents work. jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
